name: adminEmployeeTrainingNeedApplication
description: Lets an Admin submit a training need application on behalf of one or more employees, company-wide (no reporting-line restriction). Resolves every named employee (employees) FIRST via the org-wide employee search. Once confirmed, identify the need (existingNeedName or newNeedName/newNeedDescription); objective, relevance to job, benefit to employee, and benefit to company are collected only if the server requires them (per-client config). On every turn the user attaches a file, call this tool on that same turn (the chat passes a file's contents only then); files are added (several allowed) if they match PeoplesHR's allowed types and size - take one off with removeAttachments, or swap with replaceAttachments. Call with confirmed unset first for a preview and the real confirmation prompt, then again with confirmed:true, before anything is validated or saved. Write tool - submits real applications, one per named employee, on success. Draft - GetSearchedEmployeeDetails not yet captured/tested for this module.
taskName: Submitting a Training Need Application (Admin, for Any Employee)
